data.name: Aaron
data.gender_notes: Aaron is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Aharon; the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-h-r-n. Aaron, brother of Moses and the first high priest (Exodus 4). Aaron is a Hebrew name meaning “Mountain of strength; exalted”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaron expresses “Mountain of strength; exalted”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Aharon; the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaron total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
